description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Urabrask, Birgi, and Goldspan Dragon each trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Goldspan Dragon trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Goldspan Dragon +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
